X402_PAY_TO_ADDRESS.title: Seller pay-to address
X402_PAY_TO_ADDRESS.description: Optional 0x USDC address on Base for inbound x402 sales. Public discover/probe tools work without this.

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Buyer wallet private key
EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional dedicated burner key for x402.pay_and_fetch. Never use a main wallet. Leave blank on public seller hosts.
